Nine comments

Fairy Queen

This tune is not the Turlough O’Carolan planxty already listed here at the session - it is a pretty fun hornpipe though. It came to us from Scotland & is often played as a highland fling (AKA Strathspey“. I picked it up from the playing of Chris McGrath & Co. of RI, they were playing for set dancers & paired it with the ”Miss Galvin’s"
https://thesession.org/tunes/624
I think they make a great set.
~b

↳ Posted by b.maloney on April 4th, 2002.

The Fairy Queen

I got this tune off a friend a few years ago. I play it double - 32 bars - and I think I play it more like a sort of slow reel than a hornpipe.

The Fairy Queen Hornpipe

This was a popular box tune back in the sixties. I seem to remember that some box player, maybe Kieran Kelly, used to play a hornpipe selection that we all wanted to copy. The hornpipes were the Golden Eagle and The Fairy Queen. The Fairy Queen was played in C.

↳ Posted by Free Reed on July 31st, 2007.
